d: The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for a Senior Cloud Architect to join us in Qatar.

In this role, you will work as a subject-matter expert in Red Hat’s infrastructure and cloud technology. You'll answer questions about best practices around automation, reliability, scalability, maintainability, high availability, and failover setups and lead the on-site delivery and implementation of Red Hat’s technology that delivers freedom, flexibility, and outstanding performance. You will gain an understanding of our customers' infrastructures, and business issues and you will make recommendations appropriate to their environments. This is a great opportunity to build on your core base of knowledge and work in a fast-paced environment promoting Red Hat’s solutions.
We are looking for candidates with hands-on experience in infrastructure and architecture design topics.
Red Hat will support relocation to Qatar for a successful candidate.
q: Background in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (Command line skills, Linux network configuration)
Experience with Containers, container management utilities and debugging containers; also Quay
Skills in Package management, both on the CLI and with Red Hat Satellite
Hands on knowledge in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOSO18 requires OCP as the base platform to be deployed upon, so OCP knowledge becomes a prerequisite for OSP)
Architecture skills, specifically around datacenter infrastructure (networking, compute and storage)
Compute skills: Lights-Out-Management LOM (IPMI, Redfish), UEFI/BIOS, server hardware
Networking skills: Software Defined Networking SDN, Layer 2 (ARP, MAC), Layer 3 (TCP, UDP) and Layer 4 (IP), Open Virtual Switch OVS
Storage skills Software Defined Storage SDS (Ceph), SAN, NAS
Authentication and Authorization (Red Hat IDM, Active Directory)
Experience with network/datacenter design, elaboration of design and architecture documents and scoping/discovery sessions

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
r: Winning the confidence of our prospective customers through the successful delivery of discovery, analysis and design workshops that shape and influence the customer’s use cases and architecture design decisions to align with the Red Hat solution.
Designing and scoping delivery projects as well as leading consulting teams through successful customer pilot and production deployments.
The design, creation and delivery of content that enables the broader Red Hat organization to sell (pre-sales), service (consulting) and support (CEE) our solutions at scale.
Work closely with product business units, product engineering, consulting, support, and sales to ensure a world-class customer experience with Red Hat’s products.
Contribute to the development of repeatable methodologies and tools designed to scale Red Hat’s services capabilities, promote repeatable customer engagements, and lower delivery risk.
Demonstrate thought leadership in the community by producing world-class white papers, webinars, etc. and speaking at industry leading conferences.
